IMPROMPTU SPEECH
Each team is entitled for one (1) participant for each event. The name of the participant shall be submitted on September 21, 2026 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
Topics for the competition will be general.
The topic will be prepared by the SSC Academic and Literary Committee and will be verified by the Academic and Literary Consultant.
The participant should start their presentation after reading the question.
The participants will deliver impromptu speeches in English or "Dagliang Talumpati" (spontaneous speeches) in Filipino, discussing the topic they have drawn. They will share their perspectives, insights, and potential solutions to the issue at hand.
The contestant will be given a maximum of 3 minutes for delivery. A point fifty (.50) point shall be deducted from the total score of the contestant per judge’s sheet for every 10 seconds excess of the time allotted.
Presentation can be conversational or oratorical or a combination of conversation and discourse.
Sound effects, backgrounds, or props are not allowed.
The participants are required to wear formal attire. For men, this entails long sleeves, pants or slacks, and closed-toe shoes, while women are expected to wear dresses that are not above the knee. Violating the dress code will result in a deduction of 10 points.
There will be an official clock to be displayed and will be provided by the OFFICIAL TABULATORS for the benefit of the audience and consistency of the time. The timer will start as soon as the bell rings.
The time keeper from the OFFICIAL TABULATORS will announce the time the contestant has spoken.
Flags will be raised to indicate the time of his/her performance. Yellow flag means warning (30 seconds before the maximum time of delivery) and the red flag means maximum time has reached.
The verdict of the jury is final.
Judging Criteria

criteria.label: Content (related to topic, totality, and structural clarity)
Expression (voice, pronunciation, and appropriate use of words)
Attitude or Personality (posture, gesture, or act of direct interaction)

name: Maluwag na Talumpati
irr:
MALUWAG NA TALUMPATI
Ang paksa ng talumpati ay ibibigay ng Lupon ng Inampalan sa mismong araw ng patimpalak.
Ang bawat kalahok ay bibigyan ng isang (1) minutong paghahanda bago ang kanilang pagsasalita.
Ang talumpati ay dapat tumagal ng hindi bababa sa tatlong (3) na minuto at hindi hihigit sa limang (5) minuto. Isang (1) puntos ang ibabawas sa bawat minutong kulang o lumampas sa itinakdang oras.
Ang paglalahad ng talumpati ay maaaring sa anyo ng:
Pakikipag-usap (conversational)
Pampanitikang talumpati (oratorical)
Pinagsamang pakikipag-usap at pampanitikang talumpati
Ang paggamit ng sound effects, background music, at props ay mahigpit na ipinagbabawal.
Dapat angkop sa okasyon ang kasuotan ng mga kalahok.
Ang desisyon ng Lupon ng Inampalan ay pinal at hindi na mababago.
Pamantayan sa Pagpapasya
Paalala: Siguraduhing maging maayos, malinaw, at makabuluhan ang inyong talumpati. Maging natural at epektibo sa inyong pamamahayag upang mas mapukaw ang damdamin ng inyong tagapakinig.

name: Quiz Bowl
irr:
QUIZ BOWL
Each team is required to have three (3) participants for the said competition. Names of participants shall be submitted on September 21, 2026, 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
Questions shall be prepared solely by the Committee.
Each team must have three (3) contestants.
Contestants will answer the same set of questions in writing. Before a question is read, the contestant must raise both hands. Each team will be provided with a whiteboard, marker, and eraser provided by the SSC.
The question will be read twice by the Quizmaster. After the second reading, the Quizmaster shall say “go”; only then will the team be allowed to write the answer. Automatically, the ten-second time limit will begin with the word “go” by the Quizmaster. If a question requires enumeration and problem-solving, the time limit will be extended by ten (10) more seconds.
After the time limit, a buzzer will ring; the team should stop writing and raise their whiteboard with the answers. The proctors will validate the correctness of their answers. The whiteboard should be raised until the Quizmaster says so.
The contest will have three (3) rounds, Easy round, Average round, and Difficult round.
The Easy round will consist of fifteen (15) questions, with each correct answer worth 3 points.
The Average round will consist of ten (10) questions, with each correct answer worth 5 points.
The Difficult round will consist of five (5) questions, with each correct answer worth 10 points.
After all three rounds, the accumulated scores from each round will be tallied, and the winner will be determined based on the highest score. In the event of a tie, a tiebreaker question will be provided to determine the ultimate winner.
The duly registered teacher-coach of the team is the only person authorized to protest. All protests should be referred to the Board of Judges immediately before the Quizmaster reads the next question.

name: Spoken Poetry
irr:
SPOKEN POETRY
Each team is required to send 1 participant to showcase their talent in spoken poetry.
The spoken poetry piece may be performed in either English or Filipino.
Each participant shall perform an original spoken poetry piece that aligns with the given theme. Plagiarism is strictly prohibited.
The performance must be between 2 to 5 minutes long. A 1-point deduction per judge will be applied for every 30 seconds under or over the time limit.
The spoken poetry must be delivered from memory. Reading from a script or any written material is not allowed.
Background music and sound effects are allowed but should not overpower the performer’s voice. Minimal props may be used, but excessive use is discouraged.
Attire must be appropriate to the theme and the message of the piece. Costumes should not be overly elaborate or distracting.
Expressions, gestures, and body movements must complement the delivery and enhance the impact of the performance.
The decision of the judges is final and irrevocable.

SLOGAN TRADITIONAL AND DIGITAL POSTER MAKING CONTEST
Guidelines and Mechanics
Each team must have 3–5 members for the Traditional Slogan Poster Making category and 3–5 members for the Digital Slogan Poster Making category.
Participants must submit their names and team details to the Organizing Committee on or before the prescribed registration deadline.
The competition shall be conducted during the designated FESTIA 2026 competition period, with the official schedule and time allocations to be announced by the Organizing Committee.
The competition shall consist of two (2) categories: Traditional Slogan Poster Making and Digital Slogan Poster Making.
All entries must feature an original and relevant slogan that clearly communicates the official theme of the competition.
The slogan must be short, meaningful, creative, memorable, and appropriate for a school-based competition.
The official contest theme shall be: “Four Nations Clashing, One Spirit Soaring: Unleash the Cardinal Avatar Within."
All outputs must be submitted to the Organizing Committee within the prescribed submission period and deadline. Late submissions shall not be accepted unless otherwise authorized by the Organizing Committee.
Strict compliance with cleanliness is required in the assigned areas of the competition. Participants must clean their designated areas after each session. Failure to comply shall result in a 2-point deduction per judge. The committee shall inspect the assigned areas after each competition session.
The decisions of the Board of Judges are final and irrevocable.
Any entry containing plagiarized content, copied artwork, AI-generated artwork or design elements, or pre-made materials shall be subject to immediate disqualification.
All slogans, illustrations, designs, and other creative elements must be original works of the participating team and must be produced within the prescribed competition period.
Organizers reserve the right to use, reproduce, display, and publish the submitted entries for official FESTIA promotional, documentation, educational, or exhibition purposes, with proper acknowledgment of the participating team when applicable.
A. TRADITIONAL SLOGAN POSTER MAKING
The artwork must be created exclusively during the official contest period. Pre-drawn artwork, illustrations, outlines, lettering, or other prepared elements on the final illustration board are strictly prohibited.
Participants may conceptualize and draft their ideas on separate paper before or during the contest; however, pre-made designs may not be transferred, traced, printed, or reproduced onto the final illustration board.
The poster must prominently feature an original slogan based on the official contest theme: “Four Nations Clashing, One Spirit Soaring: Unleash the Cardinal Avatar Within."
The slogan must be clearly readable and visually integrated into the overall poster design.
Participants must bring their own materials, including coloring materials, paintbrushes, paints, pencils and drawing materials, and an illustration board (A3 or 1/4 size of a whole illustration board).
There shall be no restrictions on the type of coloring materials that may be used, including paint, oil pastel, watercolor, colored pencils, markers, and other appropriate traditional media.
Participants may freely use paint mixing, color combinations, shading, blending, and other traditional artistic techniques.
Printed images, photographs, computer-generated designs, pre-cut illustrations, stickers, or other commercially prepared visual elements shall not be allowed.
The artwork must be completed within the designated competition area and within the official competition period.
DIGITAL SLOGAN POSTER MAKING
The digital poster must be created exclusively during the official contest period using a computer, laptop, tablet, or other approved digital device.
Participants may prepare their concept, slogan ideas, and general planning before the competition; however, the final digital artwork must be created during the official competition period.
The digital poster must prominently feature an original slogan based on the official contest theme: “Four Nations Clashing, One Spirit Soaring: Unleash the Cardinal Avatar Within."
The slogan must be original, readable, creative, relevant, and clearly connected to the official theme.
Participants may use commonly available digital design and editing applications or software, provided that the final artwork is created by the participating team during the contest.
Participants must provide their own laptop, computer, tablet, or other necessary digital equipment, including chargers and other accessories needed to complete their entry.
Pre-made templates, stock poster designs, downloaded posters, copied artwork, or previously completed digital compositions may not be used as the final entry.
AI-generated images, AI-generated artwork, AI-generated slogans, and AI-generated design elements are strictly prohibited.
The final digital poster must be submitted in the file format, resolution, dimensions, and submission method prescribed by the Organizing Committee.
Participants may be required to submit the editable/source file together with the final output for verification and authentication.

name: Retro Hip-Hop Dance
irr:
RETRO HIPHOP DANCE COMPETITION
GUIDELINES
Each team shall be required to have their own participating team.
Each team shall perform on the designated day of the Intramurals.
Each team must consist of a minimum of 8 and a maximum of 15 members.
Time Limit: Each performance must be 4–7 minutes, inclusive of entrance and exit.
A 1-point deduction per judge shall be imposed for every 30 seconds of excess performance time.
The performance must showcase a Hip-Hop Retro theme, incorporating dance styles, music, movements, and elements inspired by the 1980s, 1990s, and/or early 2000s.
The use of props is allowed, provided that they are safe and appropriate for the performance. Props that may cause harm, including fire, pyrotechnics, or other hazardous materials, are strictly prohibited.
Costumes shall be at the discretion of each team, provided that they are appropriate, decent, and consistent with the Hip-Hop Retro theme. Suggestive, overly revealing, or lewd attire is not advisable.
Dangerous stunts, lifts, or acrobatic movements that may endanger performers are strictly prohibited, such as double back-tucks, uncontrolled flips, or other high-risk maneuvers.
Teams are encouraged to incorporate retro-inspired fashion, iconic Hip-Hop movements, formations, musical transitions, and creative interpretations of the selected era while maintaining originality and entertainment value.
All music and choreography must be appropriate for a school-based Intramurals event. Profane, offensive, discriminatory, or sexually explicit content is strictly prohibited.
There shall be a 0.5-point deduction per judge for every rule violation. Such deductions shall be determined by the Chairman of the Board of Tabulators, duly coordinated with the concerned members and in consultation with the Board of Judges.
CRITERIA FOR JUDGING
MODIFIED CONTEMPORARY DUO
Guidelines and Mechanics
Each team shall provide one (1) entry consisting of one (1) pair of participants.
The Modified Contemporary Duo is open to participants of any gender. The pair may be composed of any gender combination, including but not limited to male-female, male-male, female-female, LGBTQ+ participants, and other gender identities or expressions.
No participant shall be disqualified or disadvantaged based on sex, gender identity, gender expression, or sexual orientation. All participants shall be given equal opportunity to compete.
The duo may choose from the following themes or concepts:
Love and Relationships
Social Issues
Inner Turmoil
Joy and Celebration
Participants may also present an original concept, provided that it is appropriate for the competition.

A fault is committed if the ball lands outside the opponents court.

You may also win by successfully maneuvering your own Flag to the opposite end of the board.)

Movements
Any player makes the first move. Players move alternately.
A player is allowed to move only one piece at a time.
A move consists of pushing a piece of an adjacent square, either forward, backward, or sideward. A diagonal move or a move of more than one square is illegal.
Challenging
As the same progresses, challenges are made resulting in the elimination of soldiers. A “challenge” is made when a soldier moves into the same square occupied by an opposing soldier. When a challenge is made, the following rules of elimination apply:
A higher ranked soldier eliminates from the board a lower ranked soldier.
If both soldiers are of equal rank, both are eliminated.
A spy eliminates any officer starting with the rank of 5 star general down to the sergeant.
The flag can be eliminated or captured by any piece including
the opponent’s flag.

The flag that moves into the same square occupied by the other flag wins the game.
For maximum interest and suspense, a natural party or arbiter is present to decide over a challenge for both players.

The game ends:
When a flag reaches the opposite end of the board.
When a player resigns.
When both players agree on a drawn position
A flag reaching the opposite end of the board may still be eliminated by an opposing piece occupying a square adjacent to the one reached by the flag. In order to win, the flag should at least be two squares or two moved ahead of any opposing piece.

Rules apply across the board to all players.
The equipment required for the game includes chalk or paint, a score sheet, a whistle, and a stopwatch. The playing court should be a rectangle of about 7.5 long and 5m wide divided into six equal rectangles.
The rules of patintero Philippines are as follows:
Single Elimination
Each team shall have 8-10 players
The game starts with a toss of a coin to decide the team that becomes the passer or runner.
There is a time limit of two minutes for each team to score. Once the two minutes elapse, the two teams change sides, and the guards become the passers and vice-versa.
The passers or runners are supposed to cross the lines from the starting point and back, to earn a point.
The line guards are positioned on the vertical lines with one on the horizontal line of the grid, making sure that their feet are always on the line.
The patintero objectives of the line guards include tagging the passers or runners with their powered or butterfly hands and blocking them from passing the lines.
Once a guard tags any of the passers, the line guards assume the position of the passers.
The team who will first get 3 points will win the game and proceed to the final round.
All players who violate the rules/mechanics will be automatically eliminated.

1. Each team shall provide one (1) entry consisting of one (1) pair of participants.

5. Participants may also present an original concept, provided that it is appropriate for the competition.

name: Modified Volleyball
irr:
MODIFIED VOLLEYBALL
GAME RULES AND POINT SYSTEM
1. Each team must have 6 participants (mix).
2. The game begins with a coin toss to decide which team serves first.
3. The net is covered with cloth or tarp so players cannot see through it.
4. A huge rubberized ball will be provided by the committee.
5. The serving team performs an underhand serve to send the huge ball over the covered net.
6. Each team is allowed a maximum of three (3) touches to return the ball.
7. Players use soft hits, passes, or pushes instead of spikes or hard strikes to safely direct the huge ball.
8. A point is scored when the ball lands inside the opponent's court, the opposing team fails to return the ball within three touches, or the ball goes out of bounds after being touched last by the opponent.
9. The game uses a rally scoring system, meaning a point is awarded on every serve.
10. When a team wins a rally and regains the right to serve, players rotate clockwise before the next serve.
11. The first team to reach 15 points wins the set; the match is played in the best of three sets.
12. Violations include catching or holding the ball, exceeding three touches, touching the net, or stepping out of bounds.
13. The team that wins two out of three sets is declared the winner.

name: Kadang Race
irr:
KADANG-KADANG RACE
GUIDELINES AND MECHANICS
1. Single elimination type.
2. Each team shall be composed of 5 players. Each team shall provide kadang or bamboo stilts. Foot steps must be 12 inches higher than the ground.
3. Teams that violate the rules and mechanics of the game will be eliminated.
4. Every player from the starting line must use the kadang to walk through the turning point and back to the starting line.
5. The first player must relay to the next player until all players of the team participate.
6. The team that finishes earlier than the other team will be the winner and may compete in the next round.
7. All players who violate the rules or mechanics will be automatically eliminated.
